
# LOGISTICS AND SUPPLY AGREEMENT (V3)

**Contract ID:** LOG-2024-V3-PROD
**Effective Date:** May 1, 2024

**Parties:** 
- **Global Logistics Corp** ("Supplier")
  - Address: 123 Logistics Way, Mumbai
  - Operations Contact: ops-support@globallogistics.com
  - Legal Notice: legal@globallogistics.com
- **Retail Hub Ltd** ("Client")
  - Contact: procurement@retailhub.com

## ARTICLE 4: PERFORMANCE STANDARDS (KPIs)

### 4.1 Monthly Delivery Volume (Volume KPI)
The Supplier shall ensure a minimum delivery volume of **300 goods** per calendar month. Failure to meet this results in a **50,000 INR** penalty.

### 4.2 Late Delivery SLA (Timeline KPI)
All orders must be delivered within 48 hours of the order date. Any delivery exceeding this window is considered "Late". If more than **5%** of monthly deliveries are late, a penalty of **10,000 INR** applies.

### 4.3 Damaged Goods Threshold (Quality KPI)
The Supplier shall maintain a damaged goods rate of less than **0.2%** per month. If the monthly average exceeds this, the Supplier must credit the Client **5,000 INR** per percentage point over the limit.

### 4.4 Order Accuracy (Accuracy KPI)
The Supplier must achieve an order accuracy rate of at least **99%**. Accuracy is measured as (Correct Items / Total Items Ordered).

### 4.5 Safety Compliance (Safety KPI)
Supplier must maintain a safety score of at least **9.0** out of 10, as measured by the monthly safety audit.
